decision.md: Read the frozen `planning-input` through session_context. Plan only, preserving the confirmed project scope. Follow planning.md for the result schema. Publish one scoped result through session_report, with ready=true and at least one independently verifiable execution subtask. Ask for clarification only when the confirmed scope is insufficient.
task.md: Read `task` and `context` through session_context. Work within the confirmed project and task scope. The current directory is private to this attempt. Use it for generated artifacts and report their project-relative paths. Apply any explicitly authorized edits to the intended project files. Verify the acceptance criteria and publish exactly one result through session_report with concrete evidence and artifact locations. If blocked, publish the concrete issue and await clarification. Do not mark the task complete yourself.
planning.md: Read the frozen planning-input. Return one session_report result payload with ready, reason, dependencies, estimate and subtasks. Example: {"ready":true,"reason":"Scope is confirmed","dependencies":[],"estimate":{"complexity":1,"workUnits":1,"durationMs":1000,"confidence":"medium"},"subtasks":[{"key":"deliver","title":"Deliver outcome","responsibility":"Work within the agreed scope","acceptance":"Verify the requested outcome","dependsOn":[],"estimate":{"complexity":1,"workUnits":1,"durationMs":1000,"confidence":"medium"}}]}. Use genuine estimates and actual dependency IDs. Subtask keys must be unique. Use only necessary subtasks, each with a verifiable outcome. Only the host creates tasks from the result.
session-protocol.md: Read scoped sections through session_context. For a result or blocker use session_report with a stable id and a message with type, content and any required payload. Wait for the host to verify execution and accept results. If a clarification is open, resolve it through the same scope before submitting the result.
